title: Resistance and component I–V characteristics
design_rationale: Define resistance and Ohm’s law before comparing metallic, filament-lamp and diode characteristics.
concepts_taught: complete the resistance-dependent part of recall and use P = VI, P = I 2R and P = V 2 / R
sketch the I–V characteristics of a metallic conductor at constant temperature, a semiconductor diode and a filament lamp
explain that the resistance of a filament lamp increases as current increases because its temperature increases

next_module_can_assume: use P = VI, P = I²R and P = V²/R after deriving the resistance-based forms from V = IR
sketch the I–V characteristics of a metallic conductor at constant temperature, a semiconductor diode and a filament lamp
explain that the resistance of a filament lamp increases as current increases because its temperature increases
next_module_must_not_assume: recall and use R = ρL / A
